principles: Map only facets explicitly supported by the reviewed seed record.
Keep life stage, role, health context, cognitive status, education, setting, delivery and geography orthogonal.
Do not infer provider or delivery context from study setting alone.
Do not infer geography from institution names unless geography is explicit.
Population nationality or ethnicity does not establish study geography.
Unmapped facets remain not_yet_extracted rather than being treated as absent.
